Package com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.in.scheduling

Class KfeChannelRebalanceWorker

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.liquidity.adapters.in.scheduling.KfeChannelRebalanceWorker
@Service public class KfeChannelRebalanceWorker extends Object
Executes recoverable circular payments with durable identity and transactional fee reservations. Ambiguous outcomes remain active until provider reconciliation; Loop execution is blocked.

  • Constructor Details

    • KfeChannelRebalanceWorker

      public KfeChannelRebalanceWorker(KfeChannelRebalanceQueueService queueService, LightningChannelGateway channelGateway, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<LightningLoopClient> loopClientProvider, KfeSystemWalletService systemWalletService, KfeBalanceService balanceService, KfeAuditLogService auditLogService, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<KfeLightningOpsMetrics> opsMetrics, @Value("${kfe.channel.rebalance-worker.enabled:true}") boolean enabled, @Value("${kfe.channel.rebalance-worker.loop-fallback-enabled:true}") boolean loopFallbackEnabled, @Value("${kfe.channel.rebalance-worker.batch-size:5}") int batchSize, @Value("${kfe.channel.rebalance-worker.max-fee-sats:5000}") long maxFeeSats, @Value("${kfe.channel.rebalance-worker.max-amount-sats:500000}") long maxAmountSats)
      Creates the scheduled rebalance consumer, clamping batch and amount limits to positive values and allowing a zero fee cap to disable reservation spending.
      Parameters:
      queueService - durable rebalance job repository and claim service
      channelGateway - LND channel and circular-payment gateway
      loopClientProvider - retained for constructor compatibility; no swaps are submitted
      systemWalletService - SYSTEM_PROFIT wallet resolver
      balanceService - fee reservation and settlement service
      auditLogService - audit event writer
      opsMetrics - optional rebalance metrics sink
      enabled - scheduled worker feature switch
      loopFallbackEnabled - compatibility setting; Loop submission remains blocked
      batchSize - requested work batch size, clamped to at least one
      maxFeeSats - fee ceiling, clamped to zero or greater
      maxAmountSats - amount ceiling, clamped to at least one satoshi
